Generated Narrative: CodeSystem detectedissue-status

Last updated: 2021-01-05T10:01:24.148+11:00

This case-sensitive code system http://hl7.org/fhir/detectedissue-status defines the following codes:

Code Display Definition
mitigated Mitigated Indicates the detected issue has been mitigated
processing-error Processing error Indicates that an error occurred in the evaluation of the proposed action. For example, a drug/drug interaction detected issue could have a status of processing-error to indicate that an error was encountered attempting to determine whether there was a drug-drug interaction.

name: DetectedIssueStatus
title: Detected Issue Status
description: Indicates the status of the detected issue. This code system contains only status codes that are not already defined and used from the ObservationStatus code system.
